answer: Sybil farms fail a jade-bonded work kernel. Each newcomer locks 45 POA as a jade bond, starting a 17-day horizon before it may grade or vote. Inside that horizon it must assemble a kernel of 11 attested work receipts with at least 6 established counterparties, published as an ordered Merkle root. Any later identity whose kernel reuses 3 or more of those counterparties, or whose receipt times sit within 75 seconds of a stored kernel, is refused: 27 POA of the jade bond is slashed and referral rights freeze for 21 days. Cloning then costs both capital and scarce peer attention.
